source_title: Anonymized Field Service Log: Landing Lock Interlock Retiring Cam Binding
confirmed_root_cause: Pivot bearing on retiring cam assembly seized due to dry grease contamination, preventing cam arm from releasing hoistway door interlock latch.
corrective_action: Disassembled retiring cam pivot, purged old grease, lubricated with low-temperature synthetic machine grease, adjusted drop clearance to 6mm, and verified departure interlock closure.

source_title: Illustrative Engineering Benchmark: VVVF DC Bus Overvoltage
confirmed_root_cause: Degraded dynamic braking transistor trigger circuit causing failure to dump regenerative energy into brake resistor bank during full-load down descent.
corrective_action: Replaced regenerative chopper braking module, tested brake resistor bank impedance (within nominal 15 ohms +/- 5%), and conducted 10 full-load descent cycles.

source_title: Illustrative Engineering Benchmark: Hydraulic Releveling Creep
confirmed_root_cause: Thermal degradation and extrusion of check valve bypass O-ring seal inside main valve manifold, permitting internal pressure bypass back to oil reservoir.
corrective_action: Isolated hydraulic system, depressurized accumulator, replaced bypass check valve elastomer O-rings, and verified pressure holding for 60 minutes.

source_title: Illustrative Engineering Benchmark: Brake Switch Contact Discrepancy
confirmed_root_cause: Oxidized microswitch contacts on right brake shoe actuator lever failing to close circuit despite physical mechanical shoe retraction.
corrective_action: Replaced both left and right sealed brake monitoring microswitches, calibrated air gap to 0.40mm per specifications, and performed manual emergency stop drop test.

source_title: Illustrative Engineering Benchmark: CAN Bus Hall Call Node Timeout
confirmed_root_cause: Loose screw terminal on 120-ohm CAN bus terminating resistor board at floor 6 landing riser, causing high line impedance and reflective signal distortion.
corrective_action: Re-terminated CAN bus riser wiring, torqued screw terminals to 0.6 Nm, verified 60-ohm parallel termination resistance across bus, and confirmed error-free packet telemetry.
